text: I checked SX against the live feed, and I also need to correct my first answer. The '8' I quoted was leagues, not games. SX has about 11,900 markets over 644 games, and its team names do match ours. Games like Marshall v South Alabama and Baylor v Kansas already show SX behind their fair odds. The reason you rarely see SX or Polymarket is that most of the +EV list is player props (Embiid, Wagner, Daniels...), and SX lists only about 160 player markets, all touchdown yes/no. Polymarket is similar. So for those bets there is nothing to match. The game lines that do exist on SX are in use. The gaps I can close: (1) SX soccer totals and Asian handicaps (about 4,600 markets) and half and quarter lines aren't read yet, (2) the SX moneylines are all flagged non-main, so I'll check they aren't being skipped, (3) show on each bet which feeds priced it. I'll start with (2), then (1). No key needed; SX's public market list works from here.
